per_fire_headline.refusal_note: The estimand REFUSES a zero half rather than reporting -inf, and the three refused fires all have a positive early half and an EXACTLY ZERO late half. Excluding them silently would drop the three most decelerating fires we have; both counts are therefore stated and neither is called the answer.
per_fire_headline.why_this_table_exists: 6 of 14 blocks hold more than one fire and t0 is a per-fire index, so a multi-fire block interleaves two clocks. The block table is the deliverable; this says whether it is a statement about FIRES.

heterogeneity.cv_caveat: stage_decay changes SIGN, so its mean can approach zero and the CV can be arbitrarily large without the spread changing. Read the SD and the IQR.

time_reversal_control.note: Exact on every single-fire block. The residual on multi-fire blocks is the documented distinct-ages caveat meeting duplicated per-fire t0 values, not a defect in the estimand — it moves no sign. This doubles as the POSITIVE CONTROL for the read-off: reversed, the same code lands on the refuted branch.

thin_block_check.spearman_note: Strongly NEGATIVE would mean the decelerating blocks are just the fat ones.
thin_block_check.controls_note: A synthetic beta=-1.5 series must keep its sign at the thin block's n, so the procedure CAN see a decay in a sample that small. A flat series must never be reported as decelerating: it reads EXACTLY 0.0, so the negative fraction is 0.0 rather than 0.5 — the estimand refuses to manufacture a sign from no signal.

age_permutation_null.note: AGE is permuted within each block; every growth value, window count and thinness is preserved. This is the null in which fires have no stage. It must centre near n/2 — if it did not, the count would be a property of the estimand and not of fires.

record_hygiene.note: Windows after a fire's LAST growth. GOFER records run to the end of the product's scan, not to containment, and any stage statistic reads a dead tail as deceleration. Escalated to @data in BLOCKERS.md with the exact hours; the trailing-trim sensitivity above measures what it is worth (every sign held).

sensitivity_trailing_trim.status: SENSITIVITY ONLY. The headline is the untrimmed table, because the trim is a choice made after seeing the data and the read-off was pre-registered on the windows we always score.

registry_guard.registry_refusal: 'stage_decay' is not in C6_METRICS, so nothing has ruled on whether it may decide the U0b premise check. An unregistered metric is an unchecked metric; register it with a direction and a gate_eligible flag before letting it decide anything.

not_a_verdict: NOT A VERDICT ON ANY MODEL — no forecast was computed, so nothing here can be a gate result. It IS the pre-registered read-off on the PREMISE, and the estimand is the one D3 licensed (UNCHANGED_SINCE_D3). stage_decay remains unlicensed for adjudication (registry: NOT_LICENSED).
